# !!! THIS IS A GENERATED FILE !!! DON'T EDIT ME MANUALLY !!!
# Instead edit donico.yml and run bin/rake generate-earthfile

VERSION 0.7

############
# BOOKWORM #
############

bookworm-latest-docker-build:
  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
  ARG BOOKWORM_VERSION
  ARG BUILD_DATE
  ARG DISTRO_NAME

  FROM DOCKERFILE -f Dockerfile --build-arg BOOKWORM_VERSION="$BOOKWORM_VERSION" --build-arg BUILD_DATE="$BUILD_DATE" --build-arg DISTRO_NAME="$DISTRO_NAME" --platform "$TARGETPLATFORM" .
  SAVE IMAGE --cache-hint bookworm/"$BOOKWORM_VERSION"/"$DISTRO_NAME":"$BUILD_DATE"

bookworm-latest-docker-push:
  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
  ARG BOOKWORM_VERSION
  ARG BUILD_DATE
  ARG DISTRO_NAME

  FROM --platform "$TARGETPLATFORM" +bookworm-latest-docker-build
  SAVE IMAGE --push registry.example.net/debian/bookworm:latest

bookworm-latest-build:
  BUILD --platform "linux/amd64" --platform "linux/386" --platform "linux/arm64" +bookworm-latest-docker-build

bookworm-latest-push:
  BUILD --platform "linux/amd64" --platform "linux/386" --platform "linux/arm64" +bookworm-latest-docker-push
